sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:83363
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2924 of 2023

Applicant :- Charan Singh Yadav @ Charan Yadav
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Govt. Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pradeep Kumar,Pradeep Kumar Mishra
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.

1. Heard Sri Pradeep Kumar Mishra, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Anurag
Verma, learned A.G.A. appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing
Case Crime No. 601 of 2023, under Sections 409, 420 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Gomti
Nagar, District Lucknow.

3.  The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 10.10.2023 against two persons, including the applicant, stating that the accused persons used to work in Suvidha Microfin,
which is a registered Micro Finance Institution and they embezzled Rs. 10,85,000/- of the company.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail application it has been contended that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in the present case.

entities.text: Charan Singh Yadav @ Charan Yadav vs State Of U.P Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Govt
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The informant had removed the applicant from the service in the month of May, 2022 without giving salary.

6. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that at the time of his appointment, the informant had taken a blank cheque from the applicant as security and when he demanded return of the cheque after his removal from service, the same was declined.

The complainant has fraudulently filled up the amount of Rs. 1,20,000/- in the cheque, presented the same to bank, and filed a complaint No. 1423 of 2022 in the court of Civil Judge (Senior Division) F.T.C., Gautam Buddh Nagar, under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instrument Act.

entities.text: Civil Judge (Senior Division) F.T.C., Gautam Buddh Nagar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 7. Co-accused Pradeep Kumar Pandey @ Pradeep Pandey has been granted anticipatory bail by means of the order dated 1412.2023 passed in CRIMINAL MISC ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION U/S 438 CR.P.C. No.2877 of 2023.
8. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

9. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the F.I.R has been lodged on 10.10.2023, without disclosing the date of removal of the applicant from service in May, 2022; that the applicant has no previous criminal history, and a co-accused has been granted bail, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
10. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
